title: Graph-based collaboration index
motivation: Siloing is relational; a review graph can expose cross-role edges.
design_change: Add 'silo_index' via normalized inter-role edge ratio; test sensitivity vs. team size.
expected_effect: Clearer separation signal between BMAD and siloed settings.
threats_to_validity: Org reorg confounding; control by stratification.

title: WIP-limit × Orchestration efficiency ablation
motivation: BMAD may rely on orchestration; test if gains vanish with high WIP.
threats_to_validity: Sim realism; calibrate with observational quantiles.
